summary: Make per-parent fan-out opt-in on a default sync, cap the followers page size, and curtail sync to one page per resource under a verification harness.
reason: Per-parent dependents issue one request per parent row, so a bare sync fired thousands of LinkedIn-backed calls: the exact pacing LinkedIn restricts accounts for, and redundant because the flat routes already return those records. /users/followers also rejected the spec-advertised page size with 400 errors/limit_too_high.
validated_outcome: Default sync dropped from 7m44s to a bounded walk; harness runs finish in ~12s and no longer time out.
